unknown.why: The program name of BEGIN PGM and END PGM, which starts with a digit (2.5D_..., 5X_...): Klartext allows such a name, and since WP9.3 it is one token instead of a number and a rest, but no token kind of the Klartext grammar is a program name, so it stays unknown. It is text, not code; nothing reads or rewrites it.

unknown.why: CYCLE800 written alone, without brackets, which resets the swivelled plane. A name alone in a block is read as an unknown token: the Sinumerik call rule needs the brackets, and the tokenizer rule that would read a lone name as a call was declined at M9 integration (I9) because it changed two earlier goldens (N200 MYSUB, CR15). The name itself is described in the database; only this spelling is not read as a call.
